Arakhin 10b:11-17: Tanu rabbanan: abbuv haya bammikdash, chalak haya, dak haya, shel kane haya, umimot moshe haya. tzivva hammelech vetzippuhu zahav, velo haya kolo arev, natlu et tzippuyo vehaya kolo arev kemot shehaya. tziltzol haya bammikdash, shel nechoshet haya, vehaya kolo arev, venifgam, veshalchu chachamim veheviu ummanin mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim vetikkenuhu, velo haya kolo arev, natlu et tikkuno vehaya kolo arev kemot shehaya.

Machteshet hayta bemikdash, shel nechoshet hayta, umimot moshe hayta, vehayta mefattemet et habbesamim, nitpaggema veheviu ummanin mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim vetiknuha, velo hayta mefattemet kemo shehayta, natlu et tikkunah vehayta mefattemet kemo shehayta.

Ellu shene chelim nishtayyeyru mimmikdash rishon, venitpaggemu velo haya lahem arucha, vaalehem amar david: "nechoshet memorat", "nechoshet memorak", vaalehem hu omer: "uchele nechoshet mutzehav shenayim chamudot mizzahav".
Rav ushemuel, chad amar: kol echad veechad shakul kishnayim shel zahav, vechad amar: shenehem shekulin keechad shel zahav. tane rav yosef: shenehem shekulin keechad shel zahav.
Tanya, rabbi natan omer: sheniyyim hayu, shenneemar: "shenayim", al tikre "shenayim" ella "sheniyyim".

Tane rabban shimon ben gamliel: shiloach haya mekalleach mayim bichissar, tzivva hammelech vehirchivuhu kede sheyyitrabbu memav, venitmaatu, vechazru umiatuhu vehaya mekalleach mayim, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "al yithallel chacham bechochmato veal yithallel gibbor bigvurato".
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hirdavlim lo haya bemikdash. may hirdavlim? amar abbaye: tavla guregdana, mippene shekkolo arev umearbev et hanneima.
Beitzah 25a:12-25b:8: Gemara amar rame bar abba: hefshet venittuach beola, vehu haddin lekatztzavim. mikkan limmeda tora derech eretz: shello yochal adam basar kodem hefshet venittuach.
(Leappoke) may ka mashma lan? illema leappoke midderav huna, deamar rav huna: behema bechayyeha — bechezkat issur omedet, ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nishchata.
Nishchata — bechezkat hetter omedet, ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nitrefa.
Vehaanan tenan matnitin kidrav huna! ditnan, rabbi akiva omer: afillu kezayit chay mibbet tevichatah. may lav, mibbet tevichatah mammash?
Veha tane rabbi chiyyay: mekom tevichatah mammash. ella, rame bar abba

Kidtanya: lo yochal adam shum uvatzal merosho, ella mealav. veim achal — hare ze reavtan. kayyotze vo: lo yishte adam koso bevat achat, veim shata — hare ze gargeran. tanu rabbanan: hashshote koso bevat achat — hare ze gargeran, shenayim — derech eretz, shelosha — miggasse haruach.
Veamar rame bar abba: chatzuva — mekatta raglehon derashshiayya.
Netia — mekatta raglehon dekatztzavayya udevoale niddot.

Tormosa — mekatta raglehon desanehon shel yisrael. shenneemar: "vayyosifu bene yisrael laasot hara beene Adonai vayyaavdu et habbealim veet haashtarot veet elohe aram veet elohe tzidon veet elohe moav veet elohe vene ammon veet elohe felishtim vayyaazvu et Adonai velo avaduhu".

Mimmashma shenneemar "vayyaazvu et Adonai", eni yodea shello avaduhu?! uma talmud lomar "velo avaduhu" — amar rabbi elazar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: afillu kattormos hazze sheshsholkin oto sheva peamim veochlin oto bekinnuach seuda lo asauni banay.

Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: mippene ma nittena tora leyisrael — mippene shehen azzin. tana deve rabbi yishmael: "mimino esh dat lamo". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: reuyin hallalu shettinnaten lahem dat esh. ikka deamri: datehem shel ellu — esh. sheilmale (lo) nittena tora leyisrael — en kol umma velashon yecholin laamod bifnehem.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish, shelosha azzin hen: yisrael baummot, kelev bachayyot, tarnegol baofot. veyesh omrim: af ez bivhema dakka. veyesh omrim: af tzalaf bailanot.
Berakhot 61a:21-27: Tanu rabbanan: hammartze maot leishsha miyyado leyadah kede lehistakkel bah, afillu yesh beyado tora umaasim tovim kemoshe rabbenu — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam. shenneemar "yad leyad lo yinnake ra" — lo yinnake middinah shel gehinnam.
Amar rav nachman: manoach am haaretz haya, dichtiv: "vayyelech manoach achare ishto".

Matkif la rav nachman bar yitzchak: ella meatta, gabbe elkana, dichtiv: "vayyelech elkana achare ishto", vegabbe elisha, dichtiv: "vayyakom vayyelech achareha", hachi name achareha mammash? ella achare devareha veachare atzatah, hacha name achare devareha veachare atzatah.

Amar rav ashe: ulemay dekaamar rav nachman, manoach am haaretz haya — afillu be rav name la kera, shenneemar: "vattakom rivka venaaroteha vattirkavna al haggemallim vattelachna achare haish" — velo lifne haish.
Amar rabbi yochanan: achore ari velo achore ishsha, achore ishsha velo achore avoda zara, achore avoda zara velo achore bet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelin.

Vela amaran ella dela dare midde, vei dare midde — let lan ba. vela amaran ella delekka pitcha acharina, vei ikka pitcha acharina — let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela rechiv chamara, aval rechiv chamara — let lan ba. vela amaran ella dela mannach tefillin, aval mannach tefillin — let lan ba.

Amar rav: yetzer hara dome lizvuv veyoshev ben shene mifteche hallev, shenneemar: "zevuve mavet yavish yabbia shemen rokeach". ushemuel amar: kemin chitta hu dome, shenneemar: "lappetach chattat rovetz".

Mishnah Makhshirin 4:8-5:1:
Kedera shehi melea mayim unetuna letoch hammikve ufashat av hattuma et yado letochah, temea. magga tumot, tehora. ushear kol hammashkin, temein, sheen hammayim metaharim et shear hammashkin: 
Hamemalle vekilon, ad shelosha yamim, temein. rabbi akiva omer, im niggevu, miyyad tehorim. veim lo niggevu, afillu ad sheloshim yom, temeim: 
Etzim shennaflu alehem mashkin veyardu alehem geshamim, im rabbu, tehorim. hotziam sheyyerdu alehem geshamim, af al pi sherabbu, temeim. balu mashkim temeim, af al pi shehotziam sheyyerdu alehem geshamim, tehorin. velo yassikem ella veyadayim tehorot bilvad. rabbi shimon omer, im hayu lachin vehissikan, verabbu hammashkin hayyotzin mehen al hammashkin shebbalu, tehorim: 
Mi shettaval bannahar, vehaya lefanav nahar acher veavar bo, tiharu sheniyyim et harishonim. dachahu chavero leshachro, vechen livhemto, tiharu sheniyyim et harishonim. veim kimsachek immo, hare ze vechi yuttan:
Mishnah Makhshirin 5:11-6:3:
Haishsha shehayu yadeha tehorot, umegisa vikdera temea, im hizziu yadeha, temeot. hayu yadeha temeot, umegisa vikdera tehora, im hizziu yadeha, hakkedera temea. rabbi yose omer, im natfu. hashshokel anavim bechaf moznayim, hayyayin shebbakkaf, tahor, ad sheyyeare letoch hakkeli. hare ze dome lesalle zetim vaanavim keshehen menattefin: 
Hammaale ferotav laggag mippene hakkenima, veyarad alehem tal, enam bechi yuttan. im nitkavven lechach, hare ze vechi yuttan. heelan cheresh, shote vekatan, af al pi shechishshav sheyyered alehen hattal, enan bechi yuttan, sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava: 
Hammaale et haaguddot veet hakketziot veet hashshum laggag bishvil sheyyamtinu, enan bechi yuttan. kol haaguddot shel bet hashshevakim, temein. rabbi yehuda metaher ballachim. amar rabbi meir, vechi mippene ma timmeu, ella mippene mashke happe. kol hakkemachin vehasselatot shel bet hashshevakim, temeim. hachilka, hatteragis vehattisgi, temeim bechol makom: 
Kol habbetzim bechezkat tohora, chutz mishshel mochre mashke. veim hayu mochrin immahen perot yeveshim, tehorot. kol haddagim bechezkat tuma. rabbi yehuda omer, chatichat iltit vedag hammitzri habba vekuppa vekuleyas haispanin, hare ellu vechezkat tohora. kol hatztzir bechezkat tuma. veal kullam, am haaretz neeman lomar tehorim hen, chutz mishshel daga, mippene shehen mafkidin otah etzel am haaretz. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, tzir tahor shennafal letocho mayim kol shehen, tame:
Mishnah Makhshirin 5:2-6:
Hashshat al pene hammayim, hannittazin, enan bechi yuttan. veim nitkavven lehattiz al chavero, hare ze vechi yuttan. haose tzippor bammayim, hannittazin veet shebbah, enan bechi yuttan: 
Perot sheyyarad haddelef letochan uvelalan sheyyenuggevu, rabbi shimon omer, bechi yuttan. vachachamim omrim, enan bechi yuttan: 
Hammoded et habbor ben leamko ben lerachbo, hare ze vechi yuttan, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, leamko, bechi yuttan. ulerachbo, eno vechi yuttan: 
Pashat yado o raglo o kane levor leda im yesh bo mayim, enan bechi yuttan. leda kamma mayim yesh bo, hare ze vechi yuttan. zarak even levor leda im yesh bo mayim, hannittazin, enan bechi yuttan. veet shebbaeven, tehorim: 
Hachovet al hashshelach, chutz lammayim, bechi yuttan. letoch hammayim, enan bechi yuttan. rabbi yose omer, af letoch hammayim bechi yuttan, mippene shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu im hatztzoa:
Mishnah Makhshirin 5:7-10:
Hammayim haolin bassefina uvaekel uvammeshotot, enan bechi yuttan. bammetzodot uvarshatot uvammichmarot, enan bechi yuttan. veim nier, bechi yuttan. hammolich et hassefina layyam haggadol letzarfah, hammotzi masmer laggeshamim letzarfo, hammanniach et haud baggeshamim lechabboto, hare ze vechi yuttan: 
Kasya shel shulchanot vehashshifa shel levenim, enan bechi yuttan. veim nier, bechi yuttan: 
Kol hannitztzok, tahor, chutz middevash hazzifin, vehatztzappachat. bet shammay omrim, af hammikpa shel gerisin veshel pol, mippene shehi soledet leachareha: 
Hameare mecham lecham, umitztzonen letzonen, umecham letzonen, tahor. mitztzonen lecham, tame. rabbi shimon omer, af hameare mecham lecham vechocho shel tachton yafe mishshel elyon, tame:
Mishnah Makhshirin 6:4-8:
Shiva mashkin hen. hattal vehammayim, hayyayin vehashshemen, vehaddam, vehechalav, udevash devorim. devash tzeraim, tahor, umuttar baachila: 
Toladot lammayim, hayyotzin min haayin, min haozen, min hachotem, min happe, me raglayim, ben gedolim ben ketannim, ledato veshello ledato. toladot laddam, dam shechita. babbehema uvachayya uvaofot hattehorim, vedam hakkaza lishtiyya. me chalav, kechalav. vehammochal, kashshemen, sheen hammochal yotze mide shemen, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi meir omer, af al pi sheen immo shamen. dam hashsheretz, kivsaro, metamme veeno machshir, veen lanu kayyotze vo: 
Ellu metammein umachshirin. zovo shel zav, verukko, veshichvat zaro, umeme raglav, ureviit min hammet, vedam hannidda. rabbi eliezer omer, shichvat zera enah machsheret. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, dam hannidda eno machshir. rabbi shimon omer, dam hammet eno machshir. veim nafal al haddelaat, gordah vehi tehora: 
Ellu lo metammein velo machshirin. hazzea, vehallecha serucha, vehari, vehaddam hayyotze immahem, umashke ven shemona. rabbi yose omer, chutz middamo. vehashshote me teverya, af al pi sheyyotzin nekiyyim. dam shechita babbehema, bachayya uvaofot hattemeim, vedam hakkaza lirfua. rabbi eliezer metamme vaellu. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, chalev hazzachar, tahor: 
Chalev haishsha metamme leratzon veshello leratzon, vachalev habbehema eno metamme ella leratzon. amar rabbi akiva, kal vachomer haddevarim. ma im chalev haishsha sheeno meyuchad ella liktannim, metamme leratzon veshello leratzon, chalev habbehema shehu meyuchad liktannim veligdolim, eno din sheyyetamme leratzon veshello leratzon. amru lo, lo, im timme chalev haishsha shello leratzon, sheddam maggefatah tame, yetamme chalev habbehema shello leratzon, sheddam maggefatah tahor. amar lahem, machmir ani bechalav mibbedam, shehacholev lirfua, tame, vehammakkiz lirfua, tahor. amru lo, salle zetim vaanavim yochichu, shehammashkim hayyotzin mehen leratzon, temeim, veshello leratzon, tehorim. amar lahen, lo, im amartem besalle zetim vaanavim, shettechillatan ochel vesofan mashke, tomru vechalav shettechillato vesofo mashke. ad kan hayta teshuva. amar rabbi shimon mikkan vaelach hayinu meshivin lefanav, me geshamim yochichu, shettechillatan vesofan mashke veenan metammein ella leratzon. amar lanu, lo, im amartem beme geshamim, sheen rubban laadam, ella laaratzot velailanot, verov hechalav, laadam:
Mishnah Megillah 2:1-5: Hakkore et hammegilla lemafrea, lo yatza. keraah al pe, keraah targum, bechol lashon, lo yatza. aval korin otah lalloazot belaaz. vehalloez sheshshama ashshurit, yatza:

Keraah serugin, umitnamnem, yatza. haya chotvah, dorshah, umaggihah, im kivven libbo, yatza. veim lav, lo yatza. hayta ketuva besam, uvesikra, uvekomos uvekankantom, al hanneyar veal haddiftera, lo yatza, ad shettehe ketuva ashshurit, al hassefer uvidyo:

Ben ir shehalach lichrach uven kerach shehalach leir, im atid lachazor limkomo, kore chimkomo. veim lav, kore immahen. umehechan kore adam et hammegilla veyotze bah yede chovato, rabbi meir omer, kullah. rabbi yehuda omer, meish yehudi (Ester b 5). rabbi yose omer, meachar haddevarim haelle (Ester 3:1):

Hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegilla, chutz mecheresh, shote, vekatan. rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan. en korin et hammegilla, velo malin, velo tovlin, velo mazzin, vechen shomeret yom keneged yom lo titbol, ad shettanetz hachamma. vechullan sheasu mishsheala ammud hashshachar, kasher:

Kol hayyom kasher likriat hammegilla, velikriat hahallel, velitkiat shofar, velintilat lulav, velitfillat hammusafin, velammusafin, ulevidduy happarim, ulevidduy hammaaser, ulevidduy yom hakkippurim, lassemicha, lashshechita, lattenufa, lahaggasha, lakkemitza velahaktara, lammelika, velakkabbala, velahazzaya, ulehashkayat sota, velaarifat haegla, uletaharat hammetzora:
Mishnah Megillah 2:6-3:3:
Kol hallayla kasher liktzirat haomer ulehekter chalavim veevarim. ze hakkelal, davar shemmitzvato vayyom, kasher kol hayyom. davar shemmitzvato vallayla, kasher kol hallayla:  
Bene hair shemmachru rechovah shel ir, lokchin bedamav bet hakkeneset. bet hakkeneset, lokchin teva. teva, lokchin mitpachot. mitpachot, lokchin sefarim. sefarim, lokchin tora. aval im machru tora, lo yikchu sefarim. sefarim, lo yikchu mitpachot. mitpachot, lo yikchu teva. teva, lo yikchu vet hakkeneset. bet hakkeneset, lo yikchu et harchov. vechen bemotrehen. en mochrin et shel rabbim leyachid, mippene shemmoridin oto mikkedushshato, divre rabbi yehuda. amru lo, im ken, af lo meir gedola leir ketanna: 
En mochrin bet hakkeneset, ella al tenay sheim yirtzu yachaziruhu, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, mochrim oto mimkar olam, chutz mearbaa devarim, lemerchatz ulevurseki velitvila ulevet hammayim. rabbi yehuda omer, mochrin oto leshem chatzer, vehallokeach ma sheyyirtze yaase: 
Veod amar rabbi yehuda, bet hakkeneset shecharav, en maspidin betocho, veen mafshilin betocho chavalim, veen porsin letocho metzudot, veen shotchin al gaggo ferot, veen osin oto kappandarya, shenneemar (Vayikra 26), vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem, kedushshatan af keshehen shomemin. alu vo asavim, lo yitlosh, mippene agmat nafesh:
Mishnah Megillah 3:4-4:1:
Rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot beshabbat, korin befarashat shekalim (Shemot 30). chal lihyot betoch hashshabbat, makdimin lesheavar umafsikin leshabbat acheret. bashsheniyya, zachor (Devarim 25). bashshelishit, para adumma (Bamidbar 19:2). barviit, hachodesh hazze lachem (Shemot 12). bachamishit, chozrin lichsidran. lakkol mafsikin, berashe chodashim, bachanukka uvefurim, battaaniyyot uvammaamadot uveyom hakkippurim: 
Befesach korin befarashat moadot shel torat kohanim (Vayikra 22). baatzeret, shiva shavuot (Devarim 16). berosh hashshana, bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh (Vayikra 23). beyom hakkippurim, achare mot (sham 16). beyom tov harishon shel chag korin befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim (Vayikra 23), uvishar kol yemot hechag bekarbenot hechag (Bamidbar 29): 
Bachanukka, bannesiim (sham 7). befurim, vayyavo amalek (Shemot 17). berashe chodashim, uverashe chadshechem (Bamidbar 28). bammaamadot, bemaase bereshit (Bereshit 1). battaaniyyot, berachot ukelalot (Vayikra 26). en mafsikin bakkelalot, ella echad kore et kullan. bashsheni uvachamishi uveshabbat bammincha, korin kesidran, veen olin lahem min hacheshbon, shenneemar (Vayikra 23), vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael, mitzvatan sheyyehu korin kol echad veechad bizmanno: 
Hakkore et hammegilla omed veyoshev. keraah echad, kerauha shenayim, yatzu. mekom shennahagu levarech, yevarech. veshello levarech, lo yevarech. besheni uvachamishi uveshabbat bammincha, korin shelosha, en pochatin veen mosifin alehen, veen maftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora, mevarech lefaneha uleachareha:
Mishnah Megillah 4:2-6: Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed, korin arbaa, en pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehen, veen maftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora, mevarech lefaneha uleachareha. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyesh bo musaf veeno yom tov, korin arbaa. beyom tov, chamishsha. beyom hakkippurim, shishsha. beshabbat, shiva. en pochatin mehen, aval mosifin alehen, umaftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora, mevarech lefaneha uleachareha:

En porsin et shema, veen ovrin lifne hatteva, veen nosin et kappehem, veen korin battora, veen maftirin bannavi, veen osin maamad umoshav, veen omrim birkat avelim vetanchume avelim uvirkat chatanim, veen mezammenin bashshem, pachot measara. uvakkarkaot, tisha vechohen. veadam, kayyotze bahen:

Hakkore battora lo yifchot mishshelosha fesukim. lo yikra lammeturgeman yoter mippasuk echad, uvannavi shelosha. hayu shelashtan shalosh parashiyyot, korin echad echad. medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora. vead kamma hu medalleg, ad kede shello yifsok hammeturgeman:
Hammaftir bannavi, hu pores al shema, vehu over lifne hatteva, vehu nose et kappav. veim haya katan, aviv o rabbo ovrin al yado:

Katan kore battora umetargem, aval eno pores al shema, veeno over lifne hatteva, veeno nose et kappav. pocheach pores et shema umetargem, aval eno kore vattora veeno over lifne hatteva veeno nose et kappav. suma pores et shema umetargem. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shello raa meorot miyyamav, eno pores al shema:
Mishnah Megillah 4:7-10: Kohen sheyyesh beyadav mumin, lo yissa et kappav. rabbi yehuda omer, af mi shehayu yadav tzevuot istis ufua, lo yissa et kappav, mippene shehaam mistakkelin bo:

Haomer eni over lifne hatteva vitzvuin, af bilvanim lo yaavor. besandal eni over, af yachef lo yaavor. haose tefillato agulla, sakkana veen bah mitzva. netanah al mitzcho o al pas yado, hare zo derech hamminut. tzippan zahav, unetanah al bet unkeli shello, hare zo derech hachitzonim:

Haomer yevarchucha tovim, hare zo derech hamminut. al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha, veal tov yizzacher shemecha, modim modim, meshattekin oto. hamechanne vaarayot, meshattekin oto. haomer, umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammolech (Vayikra 18), umizarach lo titten leabara bearmayuta, meshattekin oto vinzifa:

Maase reuven (Bereshit la), nikra velo mittargem. maase tamar (Bereshit lach), nikra umittargem. maase egel harishon (Shemot 32), nikra umittargem. vehashsheni (sham), nikra velo mittargem. birkat kohanim (Bamidbar 6), maase david (Shmuel b 11:27) veamnon (Shmuel b 13), lo nikrain velo mittargemin. en maftirin bammerkava (yechezkel 1), verabbi yehuda mattir. rabbi eliezer omer, en maftirin behoda et yerushalayim (yechezkel 16:2):
Mishnah Moed Katan 1:1-4:
Mashkin bet hashshelachin bammoed uvashsheviit, ben mimmayan sheyyatza vattechilla, ben mimmayan shello yatza vattechilla. aval en mashkin lo mimme haggeshamim velo mimme hakkilon. veen osin ugiyyot laggefanim: 
Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, en osin et haamma vattechilla bammoed uvashsheviit, vachachamim omrim, osin et haamma battechilla bashsheviit, umetakkenin et hammekulkalot bammoed. umetakkenin et kilkule hammayim shebbirshut harabbim vechottin otan. umetakkenin et hadderachim veet harchovot veet mikvot hammayim, veosin kol tzarche harabbim, umetzayyenin et hakkevarot, veyotzin af al hakkilayim: 
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, moshchim et hammayim meilan leilan, uvilvad shello yashke et kol hassade. zeraim shello shatu lifne hammoed, lo yashkem bammoed. vachachamim mattirin baze uvaze: 
Tzadin et haishut veet haachbarim missede hailan umissede hallavan, shello chedarko, bammoed uvashsheviit. vachachamim omrim, missede hailan kedarko, umissede hallavan shello chedarko. umekarin et happirtza bammoed, uvashsheviit bone chedarko:
Mishnah Zavim 1:1-4:
Haroe reiyya achat shel zov, bet shammay omrim, keshomeret yom keneged yom. uvet hillel omrim, kevaal keri. raa achat, uvashsheni hifsik, uvashshelishi raa shetayim o achat merubba chishtayim, bet shammay omrim, zav gamur. uvet hillel omrim, metamme mishkav umoshav, vetzarich biat mayim chayyim, ufatur min hakkarban. amar rabbi eliezer ben yehuda, modim bet shammay baze sheeno zav gamur. veal ma nechleku, al haroe shetayim o achat merubba chishtayim, uvashsheni hifsik, uvashshelishi raa achat, bet shammay omrim, zav gamur. uvet hillel omrim, metamme mishkav umoshav, vetzarich biat mayim chayyim, ufatur min hakkarban: 
Haroe keri bayyom hashshelishi lisfirat zovo, bet shammay omrim, soter shene yamim shellefanav. uvet hillel omrim, lo satar ella yomo. rabbi yishmael omer, haroe vashsheni, soter et shellefanav. rabbi akiva omer, echad haroe vashsheni veechad haroe vashshelishi, shebbet shammay omrim, satar shene yamim shellefanav. uvet hillel omrim, lo satar ella yomo. umodim beroe varvii shello satar ella yomo, beraa keri. aval im raa zov, afillu yom shevii, satar et shellefanav: 
Raa achat hayyom ushetayim lemachar, shetayim hayyom veachat lemachar, shalosh lishlosha yamim o lishlosha lelot, hare ze zav gamur: 
Raa achat vehifsik kede tevila vesippug, veachar kach raa shetayim o achat merubba chishtayim, o raa shetayim o achat merubba chishtayim, vehifsik kede tevila vesippug, veachar kach raa achat, hare ze zav gamur:
Mishnah Zevachim 10:6-11:1:
Keshem shehen kodmim behakeravatan, kach hen kodmim baachilatan. shelamim shel emesh ushelamim shel hayyom, shel emesh kodmin. shelamim shel emesh vechattat veasham shel hayyom, shelamim shel emesh kodmin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hachattat kodemet, mippene shehi kadshe kadashim: 
Uvechullam, hakkohanim rashshain leshannot baachilatan, leachlan tzeluyim, shelukim, umevushshalim, velatet letochan tivle chullin vetivle teruma, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi meir omer, lo yitten letochan tivle teruma, shello yavi et hatteruma lide fesul: 
Amar rabbi shimon, im raita shemen shehu mitchallek baazara, en atta tzarich lishol ma hu, ella motar rekike minchot yisrael, velog shemen shel metzora. im raita shemen shehu natun al gabbe haishshim, en atta tzarich lishol ma hu, ella motar rekike minchot kohanim, uminchat kohen hammashiach. sheen mitnaddevim shamen. rabbi tarfon omer, mitnaddevim shamen: 
Dam chattat shennittaz al habbeged, hare ze taun kibbus. af al pi sheen hakkatuv medabber ella vanneechalot, shenneemar (Vayikra 6), bemakom kadosh teachel, echad hanneechelet veechad happenimit teunot kibbus, shenneemar (sham), torat hachattat, tora achat lechol hachattaot:
Mishnah Zevachim 11:2-5:
Chattat pesula en damah taun kibbus, ben shehaya lah sheat hakkosher, ben shello haya lah sheat hakkosher. ezo hi shehaya lah sheat hakkosher. shellana, shennitmea, vesheyyatza. veezo hi shello haya lah sheat hakkosher. shennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu fesulin vezarku et dama: 
Nittaz min hatztzavvar al habbeged, eno taun kibbus. min hakkeren umin hayesod, eno taun kibbus. nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo, eno taun kibbus. en taun kibbus ella haddam shennitkabbel bichli verauy lehazzaya. nittaz al haor ad shello hufshat, eno taun kibbus. mishshehufshat, taun kibbus, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi eliezer omer, af mishshehufshat eno taun kibbus. eno taun kibbus ella mekom haddam, vedavar shehu rauy lekabbel tuma, verauy lechibbus: 
Echad habbeged veechad hassak veechad haor, teunin kibbus bemakom kadosh. ushevirat keli cheres, bemakom kadosh. umerika ushetifa bichli nechoshet, bemakom kadosh. ze chomer bachattat mikkadshe kadashim: 
Beged sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim, nichnas umechabbeso vemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim, koro, venichnas umechabbeso vemakom kadosh. keli cheres sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim, nichnas veshovro vemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim, nokvo, venichnas veshovro vemakom kadosh:
Mishnah Zevachim 11:6-12:2:
Keli nechoshet sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim, nichnas umorko veshotfo vemakom kadosh. nitma chutz lakkelaim, pochato, venichnas umorko veshotfo vemakom kadosh: 
Echad shebbishshel bo veechad sheera letocho roteach, echad kadshe kadashim veechad kadashim kallim, teunin merika ushetifa. rabbi shimon omer, kadashim kallim enan teunin merika ushetifa. rabbi tarfon omer, im bishshel bo mittechillat haregel, yevashshel bo et kol haragel. vachachamim omrim, ad zeman achila. merika ushetifa, merika kimrikat hakkos, ushetifa kishtifat hakkos. merika bechammin ushetifa betztzonen. vehashshappud vehaaskela magilan bechammin: 
Bishshel bo kadashim vechullin, o kadshe kadashim vekadashim kallim, im yesh bahen benoten taam, hare hakkallim neechalin kachamurin, veenan teunin merika ushetifa, veenam poslin bemagga. rakik shennaga berakik, vachaticha bachaticha, lo chol harakik velo chol hachatichot asurin. eno asur ella mekom shebbala: 
Tevul yom umechussar kippurim, enan cholkim bakkodashim leechol laarev. onen, nogea veeno makriv, veeno cholek leechol laarev. baale mumin, ben baale mumin kevuin, ben baale mumin ovrin, cholkin veochlin, aval lo makrivin. vechol sheeno rauy laavoda, eno cholek babbasar. vechol sheen lo babbasar, en lo vaorot. afillu tame vishat zerikat damim vetahor bishat hekter chalavim, eno cholek babbasar, shenneemar (Vayikra 7), hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana: 
Kol shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah, lo zachu hakkohanim beorah, shenneemar (sham), olat ish, ola shealta leish. ola shennishchata shello lishmah, af al pi shello alta labbealim, orah lakkohanim. echad olat haish veechad olat haishsha, orotehen lakkohanim:
Mishnah Zevachim 12:3-6:
Orot kadashim kallim labbealim, veorot kadshe kadashim lakkohanim. kal vachomer, ma im ola, shello zachu vivsarah, zachu veorah, kadshe kadashim, shezzachu vivsarah, eno din sheyyizku veorah. en mizbeach yochiach, sheen lo or mikkol makom: 
Kol hakkodashim sheera bahem pesul kodem lehefshetan, en orotehem lakkohanim. leachar hefshetan, orotehem lakkohanim. amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim, miyyamay lo raiti or yotze levet hasserefa. amar rabbi akiva, middevarav lamadnu, shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa, sheyyeotu hakkohanim beoro. vachachamim omrim, en lo rainu reaya, ella yotze levet hasserefa: 
Parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim, bizman shehem nisrafin kemitzvatan, nisrafin bevet haddeshen umetammein begadim. veim enan nisrafin kemitzvatan, nisrafin bevet habbira veenam metammein begadim: 
Hayu sovlin otam bemotot. yatzu harishonim chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu, harishonim metammein begadim, vehaacharonim enan metammein begadim, ad sheyyetzeu. yatzu ellu vaellu, ellu vaellu metammein begadim. rabbi shimon omer, ellu vaellu enan metammein begadim, ad sheyyitztzat haur berubban. nittach habbasar, en hassoref metamme vegadim:
Mishnah Zevachim 13:1-4:
Hashshochet vehammaale vachutz, chayyav al hashshechita vechayyav al haaliyya. rabbi yose haggelili omer, shachat bifnim veheela vachutz, chayyav. shachat bachutz veheela vachutz, patur, shello heela vachutz ella davar pasul. amru lo, af hashshochet bifnim umaale vachutz, kevan shehotzio, pesalo: 
Tame sheachal, ben kodesh tame uven kodesh tahor, chayyav. rabbi yose haggelili omer, tame sheachal tahor, chayyav. vetame sheachal tame, patur, shello achal ella davar tame. amru lo, af tame sheachal tahor, kevan shennaga bo, timmeahu. vetahor sheachal tame, patur, sheeno chayyav ella al tumat hagguf: 
Chomer bashshechita mibbaaliyya, uvaaliyya mibbashshechita. chomer bashshechita, shehashshochet lehedyot, chayyav, vehammaale lehedyot, patur. chomer baaliyya, shenayim sheachazu vesakkin veshachatu, peturim. achazu veevar veheeluhu, chayyavin. heela, vechazar veheela, vechazar veheela, chayyav al kol aliyya vaaliyya, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yose omer, eno chayyav ella achat, veeno chayyav ad sheyyaale lerosh hammizbeach. rabbi shimon omer, afillu heela al hassela o al haeven, chayyav: 
Echad kadashim kesherin veechad kadashim pesulin shehaya fesulan bakkodesh, vehikrivan bachutz, chayyav. hammaale chazzayit min haola umin haemurin bachutz, chayyav. hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen hammashiach, uminchat nesachin, shehikriv meachad mehen kazayit bachutz, chayyav. rabbi elazar poter, ad sheyyakriv et kullo. vechullam shehikrivan bifnim veshiyyer bahen kazzayit vehikrivan bachutz, chayyav. vechullam shechasru chol shehen, vehikrivan bachutz, patur:
Mishnah Zevachim 13:5-14:1:
Hammakriv kadashim veemurehem bachutz, chayyav. mincha shello nikmetza vehikrivah bachutz, patur. kematzah, vechazar kumtzah letochah, vehikrivah bachutz, chayyav: 
Hakkometz vehallevona, shehikriv et achad mehen bachutz, chayyav. rabbi elazar poter ad sheyyakriv et hashsheni. echad bifnim veechad bachutz, chayyav. shene veziche levona, shehikriv et achad mehen bachutz, chayyav. rabbi elazar poter, ad sheyyakriv et hashsheni. echad bifnim veechad bachutz, chayyav. hazzorek miktzat damim bachutz, chayyav. rabbi elazar omer, af hamenassech me chag bechag bachutz, chayyav. rabbi nechemya omer, sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz, chayyav: 
Hammolek et haof bifnim veheela vachutz, chayyav. malak bachutz veheela vachutz, patur. hashshochet et haof bifnim veheela vachutz, patur. shachat bachutz veheela vachutz, chayyav. nimtza, derech hechshero mibbifnim, peturo vachutz. derech hechshero vachutz, peturo vifnim. rabbi shimon omer, kol shechayyavin alav vachutz, chayyavin al kayyotze vo vifnim, sheheelahu vachutz, chutz min hashshochet bifnim umaale vachutz: 
Hachattat shekkibbel damah bechos echad, natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim, bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz, chayyav, shekkullo rauy lavo vifnim. kibbel damah bishne chosot, natan shenehem bifnim, patur. shenehen bachutz, chayyav. echad bifnim veechad bachutz, patur. echad bachutz veechad bifnim, chayyav al hachitzon, vehappenimi mechapper. lema haddavar dome, lemafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot. shachat shetehen bifnim, patur. shachat shetehen bachutz, chayyav. achat bifnim veachat bachutz, patur. achat bachutz veachat bifnim, chayyav al hachitzona, vehappenimit mechapperet. keshem sheddamah poter et besarah, kach hu foter et besar chavertah: 
Parat chattat shesserafah chutz miggittah, vechen sair hammishtalleach shehikrivo vachutz, patur, shenneemar (Vayikra 17), veel petach ohel moed lo hevio. kol sheeno rauy lavo el petach ohel moed, en chayyavin alav:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4:10-12: En mevarchin al ochel min kol hoochalin velo al mashke min kol hammashkin ad sheyyavo lefanav. veim berech veachar kach hevio lefanav tzarich lachazor ulevarech. natal ochel uverech alav venafal miyyado venisraf o shetafo nahar notel acher vechozer umevarech alav af al pi shehu meoto hammin. vetzarich lomar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed al beracha rishona kede shello lehotzi shem shamayim levattala. omed adam al ammat hammayim umevarech veshote af al pi shehammayim shehayu lefanav bishat habberacha enam hammayim sheshshata mippene shellechach nitkavven techilla:

Devarim habbaim betoch hasseudda vehen mechamat hasseudda enan tzerichin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem ella birkat hammotzi shebbattechilla uvirkat hammazon shebbassof poteret hakkol shehakkol tefela lasseudda. udevarim sheenan mechamat hasseudda shebbau betoch hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem. udevarim habbaim leachar hasseudda ben mechamat hasseudda ben shello mechamat hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehen uleacharehem:

Beshabbatot uveyamim tovim uvisudat hakkazat haddam uveshaa sheyyatza min hammerchatz vechayyotze bahen sheadam kovea seuddato al hayyayin. im berech al hayyayin shellifne hammazon patar et hayyayin sheshshata leachar hammazon kodem sheyyevarech birkat hammazon. aval bishar hayyamim tzarich lachazor ulevarech battechilla al hayyayin shel achar hammazon. ba lahen yayin betoch hammazon kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo sheen bet habbelia panuy sheyyaanu amen veeno poter et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4:8-9: Hayu shotin veamru bou unevarech birkat hammazon o bou unekaddesh kiddush hayyom neesar alehem lishtot ad sheyyevarchu o yekaddeshu. veim ratzu lachazor velishtot kodem sheyyevarchu o yekaddeshu af al pi sheenam rashshaim tzerichim lachazor ulevarech techilla bore peri haggafen veachar kach yishtu. aval im amru bou venavdil en tzerichin lachazor ulevarech:

Hayu mesubbin lishtot yayin uva lahen min yayin acher kegon shehayu shotin adom veheviu shachor o yashan veheviu chadash enan tzerichin levarech birkat hayyayin paam sheniyya. aval mevarchin baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hattov vehammetiv:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5:1-3: Nashim vaavadim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon. vesafek yesh baddavar im hen chayyavin min hattora lefi sheen kavua lah zeman o enam chayyavin min hattora. lefichach en motziin et haggedolim yede chovatan. aval hakketannim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon middivre sofrim kede lechannechan bemitzvot:

Shelosha sheachlu pat keechad chayyavin levarech birkat hazzimmun kodem birkat hammazon. vee zo hi birkat hazzimmun. im hayu haochlim mishshelosha ad asara mevarech echad mehem veomer nevarech sheachalnu mishshello vehakkol onin baruch sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. vehu chozer umevarech baruch sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu:
Veachar kach omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hazzan et haolam kullo betuvo ad sheggomer arba berachot. vehen onin amen achar kol beracha uveracha:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5:4-5: Hayu haochlin measara ulemala mezammenin beshem. ketzad. hamevarech omer nevarech lelohenu sheachalnu mishshello. vehen onin baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. vehu chozer veomer baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. umatchil birkat hammazon:

Hassoed bevet chatanim mishsheyyatchilu lehitassek betzarche seuddat nissuin velahachinah ad sheloshim yom achar hannissuin mevarech nevarech shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello. vehem onim baruch shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello vechulei. veim hayu asara mevarech nevarech lelohenu shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello. vehem onin baruch elohenu shehassimcha vechulei. vechen seudda sheosin otah achar hannissuin mechamat hannissuin ad shenem asar chodesh mevarech shehassimcha bimono:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5:6-7: Hakkol chayyavin bevirkat hazzimmun kederech shechayyavin bevirkat hammazon. afillu kohanim sheachlu kadshe hakkadashim baazara. vechen kohanim veyisreelim sheachlu keechad veachlu hakkohanim teruma veyisrael chullin chayyavin bezimmun kechiyyuvan bevirkat hammazon:

Nashim vaavadim uketannim en mezammenin alehen aval mezammenin leatzman. velo tehe chavura shel nashim vaavadim uketannim mippene happeritzut. aval nashim mezammenot leatzman o avadim leatzman uvilvad shello yezammenu beshem. anderoginus mezammen lemino veeno mezammen lo lenashim velo laanashim mippene shehu safek. vehattumtum eno mezammen kelal. katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin mezammenin alav veaf al pi shehu keven sheva o keven shemone. umitztaref ben leminyan shelosha ben leminyan asara lezammen alav. vehannachri en mezammenin alav:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:12-13:
Habbone kol shehu chayyav. hammashve pene hakkarka bevayit kegon shehishpil tel o mille guma o gay hare ze bone vechayyav. echad natan et haeven veechad natan et hattit hannoten hattit chayyav. uvannidbach haelyon afillu heela et haeven vehinnichah al gabbe hattit chayyav. shehare en mannichin aleha tit acher. vehabbone al gabbe kelim patur: 
Haose ohel kavua hare ze toledet bone vechayyav. vechen haose kele adama kegon tannur vechavit kodem sheyyissarfu hare ze toledet bone vechayyav. vechen hamegabben et haggevina hare ze toledet bone. veeno chayyav ad sheyyegabben kigrogeret. hammachnis yad hakkardom betoch haetz shello hare ze toledet bone. vechen kol kayyotze bo. vechen hattokea etz beetz ben shettaka bemasmer ben shettaka baetz atzmo ad shennitached hare ze toledet bone vechayyav:
Niddah 30b:4-14: Rabbi yishmael omer: yom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar ulenidda kulei. tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: timme vetiher bezachar, vetimme vetiher binkeva.
Ma keshettimme vetiher bezachar yetzirato keyotze vo, af keshettimme vetiher binkeva yetziratah kayyotze bah. amru lo: en lemedin yetzira mittumea.

Amru lo lerabbi yishmael: maase bikleoppatra malkat alekkesanderos, shennitchayyeyvu shifchoteha hariga lammalchut, uvedakan umetzaan ze vaze learbaim veechad! amar lahen: ani mevi lachem reayay min hattora, veattem meviin li reayay min hashshotim?!
May reaya min hattora? illema timme vetiher bezachar vetimme vetiher binkeva kulei. ha kaamri leh: en danin yetzira mittumea!
Amar kera "teled", hosif lah hakkatuv leda acheret binkeva.
Umay reaya min hashshotim? emar: nekeva kedim, veiabbur arbein yomin kamme zachar.
Verabbanan: samma denaftza ashkinhu. verabbi yishmael: ikka gufa dela mekabbel samma.

Amar lahem rabbi yishmael: maase bikleppatra malkat yevavnim, shennitchayyeyvu shifchoteha hariga lammalchut, uvedakan umetzaan zachar learbaim veechad, unekeva lishmonim veechad. amru lo: en meviin reaya min hashshotim.
May tama? hach dinkeva iyyaytara arbein yomin, vahadar iabbar.
Verabbi yishmael: leshomer masrinhu. verabbanan: en appotroppos laarayot, ema shomer gufeh ba aleha.
Vedilma: i karuhu lehach dinkeva bearbein vechad, hava mishtachcha kezachar? amar abbaye: besimanehon shavin.

Shevuot 38b:26-39a:9: Tanu rabbanan: shevuat haddayyaynin, af hi bilshonah neemra.
Shekkol haolam kullo nizdaza beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu besinay "lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav".

Vechol averot shebbattora neemar bahen "venakke", vechan neemar "lo yenakke". vechol averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu, vechan mimmennu umimmishpachto; shenneemar: "al titten et picha lachati et besarecha" – veen besaro ella kerovo, shenneemar: "umibbesarcha lo titallam".
Vechol averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu, vechan mimmennu umikkol haolam kullo; shenneemar: "alo vechachesh".
Veema ad deaved lehu lechullehu! la salka datach; dichtiv: "mippene ala avla haaretz", uchetiv: "al ken teeval haaretz veumlal kol yoshev bah".

Vechol averot shebbattora – im yesh lo zechut, tolin lo shenayim ushelosha dorot; vechan nifrain mimmennu lealtar – shenneemar: "hotzetiha neum Adonai tzevaot, uvaa el bet haggannav veel bet hannishba bishmi lashshaker, velane betoch beto vechillattu veet etzav veet avanav".

"Hotzetiha" – lealtar. "uvaa el bet haggannav" – ze haggonev daat habberiyyot; sheen lo mamon etzel chavero, vetoano umashbio. "veel bet hannishba bishmi lashshaker" – kemashmao. "velane betoch beto vechillattu veet etzav veet avanav" – ha lamadta, devarim sheen esh umayim mechallin otan, shevuat sheker mechalla otan.

Im amar: "eni nishba" – potrin oto miyyad. veim amar: "hareni nishba" – haomdin sham omrim ze laze: "suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim haelle vegomer". ucheshemmashbiin oto omrim lo: heve yodea, shello al datecha anu mashbiin otcha, ella al daat hammakom veal daat bet din.
Shekken matzinu bemoshe rabbenu, keshehishbia et yisrael, amar lahen: deu, shello al datechem ani mashbia etchem, ella al daat hammakom veal dati; shenneemar: "velo ittechem levaddechem vegomer".
"Ki et asher yeshno po" – en li ella otan haomdin al har sinay; dorot habbaim vegerim haatidin lehitgayyer – minnayin? talmud lomar: "veet asher enennu".
Sotah 44a:3-7: "Mi haish asher eras ishsha kulei", tanu rabbanan: "asher eras", echad hameares et habbetula, veechad hameares et haalmana, veechad shomeret yavam. vaafillu chamishsha achin, umet echad mehem bammilchama — kullan chozrin. "lo lakach", "velo lekachah" — perat lealmana lakkohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin.
Lema dela kerabbi yose haggelili, dei rabbi yose haggelili, ha amar "hayyare verach hallevav" — ze hammityayre meaverot shebbeyado?
Afillu tema rabbi yose haggelili, kidrabba. deamar rabba: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyivol, ma taam: "lo yikkach" mishshum "lo yechallel" — mishshum hachi eno loke ad sheyyivol.

Tanu rabbanan: "asher bana", "asher nata", "asher eras", limmeda tora derech eretz: sheyyivne adam bayit, veyitta kerem, veachar kach yissa ishsha. veaf shelomo amar bechochmato: "hachen bachutz melachtecha veattedah bassade lach achar uvanita vetecha". "hachen bachutz melachtecha" — ze bayit, "veattedah bassade lach" — ze kerem, "achar uvanita vetecha" — zo ishsha.

Davar acher: "hachen bachutz melachtecha" — ze mikra, "veattedah bassade lach" — ze mishna, "achar uvanita vetecha" — ze gemara. davar acher: "hachen bachutz melachtecha" — ze mikra umishna, "veattedah bassade lach" — ze gemara, "achar uvanit vetecha" — ellu maasim tovim. rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer: "hachen bachutz melachtecha" — ze mikra umishna ugemara, "veattedah bassade lach" — ellu maasim tovim, "achar uvanita vetecha" — derosh vekabbel sachar.
Zohar, Emor 38: (Vayikra 23:24) bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh, ribbi yitzchak patach, (Tehillim 81:4) tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu kariv lon legabbeh, min kol umin ovde avoda zara, veitree behu, umeatar rechika kariv lon legabbeh, hada hu dichtiv, (yehoshua 24:2) vayyomer yehoshua el kol haam ko amar Adonai elohe yisrael beever hannahar yashvu avotechem meolam. leachazaa, deha meatar rechika itree behu, vekariv lon legabbeh, uchetiv, (yehoshua 24:3) vaekkach et avichem et avraham meever hannahar vegomer. hane kerae it leistakkela behu, vechi kol yisrael la havo yade da, vechol shekken yehoshua.

Ella orayyta kulah satim vegalya, kema dishma kaddisha satim vegalya, begin deorayyta kulah shema kaddisha hi, veal da ihi satim vegalya. i yisrael vihoshua havo yade, amay ketiv ko amar Adonai. ella vadday setima demilla, tivu saggi avad kudesha berich beyisrael, deitree behu baavahata, veavid lon reticha kaddisha illaa likareh, veappik lon miggo nahara illaa yakkira kaddisha, butzina dechol butzinin, begin deyitattar behu. hada hu dichtiv, ko amar Adonai beever hannahar yashvu avotechem meolam. hannahar: hahu nahar deishtemoda, veityeyda.

Meolam, may ka bae hacha. ella leachazaa chachmeta. meever hannahar meolam, ella hahu nahar olam ikre. veal da, beever hannahar yashvu avotechem meolam, leachazaa tivu ukeshot deavad kudesha berich hu leyisrael. vaekkach et avichem et avraham meever hannahar may ka mayyre. ella avraham la itdevak beh behahu nahar, kemo yitzchak deitdevak beh besitre leittakkefa.

Ta chaze, hay nahar, af al gav delav ihu dina, dinin nafke missitreh, veittakafu beh. vechad yitzchak ittakkaf (bedinoy) bivnoy, keden illain vetattain mitkannefe ledina, vechuresyay dedina ittakkan, umalka kaddisha yativ al kuresyay dedina, vedain alma, keden, tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu. zakkain innun yisrael, deyadin lesalleka kuresyay dedina, uletakkena kuresyay derachame. uvemma. bashshofar.

Ribbi abba hava yativ kammeh deribbi shimon, amar leh, ha zimnin saggiin shailna al hay shofar, may ka mayyre, vead kan la ityeyshshavna beh. amar leh, vadday hay hu berira demilla, deyisrael bayayn beyoma dedina (nusach acher da), shofar, vela keren. begin dekeren ha ityeyda bean atar ihu, uleitdabbeka dina la baena. aval ha tanenan, bemillin uveovada, baenan leachazaa uleatara millin setimin.

Ta chaze, kad hahu shofar illaa, dinhiru decholla beh, istallak vela nahir livnin, keden dina ittear, vechursevavn ittekanu leve dina, veda shofar, elo deyitzchak ikre, tukefeh deyitzchak, tushebachteh daavahan, kad istelak hahu shofar gadol, dela yanka livnin, keden yitzchak ittakkaf, veittakkan ledina bealma.

Vechad ittear hay shofar vechad bene nasha tayyvin mechataehon, bayayn lenagda kol shofar mittatta, vehahu kala salik leella, keden ittear shofara ochora illaa, veittear rachame, veistallak dina. uvaenan leachazaa ovada beshofar, leitteara shofara ochora, uleappaka behay shofar letatta, innun kale, leachazaa dechol innun kalin dilella, dichlilan kullehu behahu shofar illaa, yittearun lenafka.

Uvehane kalin diltatta, yahavin yisrael chela (lerachame mittatta veittear shofar gadol) leella, veal da baenan lezammena shofar beyoma da, ulesaddera kalin, lechavvevna beh begin leatara shofar ochora, deveh kelilan kale leella. (ulesaddera kalin bashshofar).

Sidra kadmaa, kala nafik, umitattar leella, salik rekiin, veitbaka ben ture ramae, umate legabbeh deavraham, vesharya beresheh, veitattar, veittear hu, veatkin lechuresyay. uvesifra deaggadta tanenan, beshaata dehahu kala kadmaa salik, ittear veitattar avraham, veatkin lechuresyay, pakdin aleh abba. (sefer acher abba veima) abba.

Addehachi, salleka tinyayna, takkifa (lechabbera) letavra tukefe regizin. veda sidra tinyayna, hahu kala tevira betukefoy. ucheden salleka, vechol dinin deittearun (sefer acher daataaraan) kameh ittebaru, ad desalik leatreh deyitzchak. kevan deyitzchak ittear, vechame leavraham metakken lechuresyay lekayyeyma kammeh, keden itkafya, vetavar tukepa kashya. uvehay, bae man detaka, lechavvevna libba ureuta, begin letavra chela vetukepa dedina kashya, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua, yode terua vadday.

Sidra telitaa, kala nafik, vesalik, uvaka kol innun rekiin, verachame mitaran, umate hahu kala leresheh deyaakov veyaakov ittear, vechame leavraham mittakken begisa ochora, keden achidan tarvavyyhu beh beyitzchak, da mehay sitra, veda, mehay sitra vela yachlin tukefoy lenafka levar. vehane telata sidrin, kullehu sidra chad.
Sidra ochora, kala nafik, vesalik, venatil leavraham meatreh, venagid leh letatta, laatar detukefehon deyitzchak sharyayn vekayyman leh leavraham begavavyyhu.

Sidra tinyayna, nafik kala tevira, la takkifa kekadmaa, la dechalish hahu kala detaka, ella dehahu kala lav ihu legabbe yitzchak bekadmita, detamman tukepa takkifa sharya, ella legabbe innun be dina diltatta, deinnun refuyin yattir, vechullehu chaman leavraham legabbayyhu, veitkafyayn kammeh.

Addehachi, sidra telitaa, kala nafik, vesalik, veitattar beresheh deyaakov, venagid leh letatta lehahu atar deinnun gevuran sharyayn, vekaim lokkovlayyhu, avraham mehay sitra, veyaakov mehay sitra, veinnun beemtzaita. keden itkafyayn kullehu, umishtachchin (sefer acher vameshatekakey) beatrayyhu. vehane kullehu sidra ochora tinyayna.

Sidra batraa, devayay lesalleka lon leatrayyhu, uleyayshva (sefer acher valeysheraa) benayyhu leyitzchak kemillekaddemin. begin dehay bae leyashshera leh baatreh, vela yippuk betukefoy levar, keden dinin kullehu itkafyayn, verachamin ittearu.

Al da bae lechavvevna libba ureuta behane kale, ulemehdar betiyyuveta kame marehon. keden kad yisrael metakkene umesaddere kalin biruta delibba kedka yaut, beshofara da, ahdar hahu shofar illaa, vechad ahdar, meattera leh leyaakov, veittakkan kolla. vechuresyay ochora remiu, ucheden chedu ishtechach becholla, vekudesha berich hu merachem al alma. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, deyadin lenagda uleamshacha lemarehon, middina lerachame, uletakkena kullehu almin al yedayyhu.

Ta chaze, lokovel da, telata sifrin petichin beyoma da, uchema derachamin mitarin, vedinin kashyayn itkafyayn vealin leduchetayyhu. kach hu letatta kegavvna dilella, dinin kashyayn itkafyayn veitavaru mealma. uman innun. illen innun reshaim gemurim, deinnun dinin kashyayn deitkafyayn veitavaru mealma. veal da nichtavim venechottamim vechulei. amar ribbi abba, vadday da hu berira demilla, berich rachamana deshailna veravavchna behane mile.
Amar ribbi yehuda, ketiv zichron terua, zikkaron avdenan, lechavvevna libba ureuta, yisrael avdin zikkaron letatta, bema. beovada, begin deyittear milla kehahu gavvna leella.

Amar ribbi elazar, ketiv (Tehillim 81:4) bakkese leyom chaggenu deitkasya beh sihara. vehech itkasya. ella, kad kayyeyma iva, veshimmesha la nahir, keden sihara itkasya, vela nahir. veal da, mikkamme iva shimsha la nahir, kol shekken sihara deitkasseya vela nehira. veal da bakkese leyom chaggenu, beHei, deitkasya sihara. uvema nahir. kolla betiyyuveta, uvekal shofara, dichtiv, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua keden Adonai beor panecha yehallechun.
Zohar, Pekudei 38: Amar rabbi shimon, af al gav dechol hane millin kidkamran, kudesha berich hu yahiv leh shuletanu. veruach mesaava bae leachpeya leh bechol sitrin. ta veima lecha raza chada, vela ityeyhiv legallaa bar leinnun kaddishe elyonin.

Ta chaze, lehay atar deihu ruach mesaava. kudesha berich hu yahiv leh shuletanu, lemishlat bealma, bechamma sitrin, veyachil lenazka, velet leh (nusach acher lan) reshu, leanhaga beh kelana, devaenan leistammera minneh, dela yekatreg alan bego kedushsha dilan. veal da raza chada it lan, devaenan lemehav leh ducheta zeer, bego kedushsha dilan (dela ishtechach mekatrega bego kedushsha dilan) deha miggo kedushsha nafik shuletanu dileh.

Devaenan go raza ditfillin, leatznea (sod sear shabetapeyleyn) chad saara deegla, deyippuk levar veyitchaze. deha chuta desaara da la masiv, bar dei itchabbar hay saara, veitavid kashsheura, aval pachut min da la masiv. vehahu saara bae leaala leh bego kedushsha illaa dilan, ulemehav leh ducheta, begin dela yekatreg lan bekidushan.

Veyippuk min hahu saara levar, deyitchaze, dechad chame lehahu bar nash bikdushsha illaa, vechulaka dileh mishtattef letaman, keden la yekatreg leh, vela yachil leavasha leh leella vetatta, deha ducheta yehav leh. vei hahu chulaka la yahavin leh (ducheta) behay kedushsha, yachil leavasha leh letatta, vesalik mekatrega leh leella, veamar peloni deka mekaddesh hasheta, kach vechach avad yoma peloni, vechach innun chovoy, ad deyimte dina al hahu bar nash, veyitanesh al yedoy. (vechen sair hammishtalleach).

Vechacha havo yisrael avde, dahavo yade raza da, kad sharan leitkaddesha bikdushsha illaa beyoma dechippure, havo mistakkele miyyad lemehav chulakeh lehay atar, ulemehav leh chulaka benayyhu, begin dela yishtekach mekatrega alayyhu, vela yetun leadkera chovehon deyisrael. dechamma chavilin, vechamma mashiryayn, innun deizdammenan lenatla milla minneh, kad ate lekatrega. zakkaa chulakeh, man deyachil leistammera, dela yidkerun chovoy leella, vela yashgichun aleh levish.
Addehachi havo zalgin enoy deribbi abba. amar leh, abba abba, zil tanfir keturach, veakpid bekuletach, deha razin deorayyta lezakkae ityeyhivu dichtiv, (tehillim ko) sod Adonai lireav.

Ta chaze, beyoma derosh hashshana, alma ittedan, uve dina kaddisha (kudesha berich hu) yativ, vedan kol alma. vehahu sitra achara kaim missitra da, vechol innun deittedanu lemota ashgach alayyhu, veitreshimu kameh. uveshaata deyisrael mitare rachame, behahu kol shofar, keden itarveva leh kolla, dela yada vela mashgach, beinnun deittedanu. ad dilvatar kol innun dela mehaddere betiyyuveta, veigzar alayyhu mota, vadday nafkin pitkin mibbe malka, veitmesaru leh, kevan deitmesaru leh, la ahadru pitkin, ad deitavid dina.

Veyisrael kullehu, bayayn leistammera minneh, kol shekken bar nash bilchodoy. (vechol shekken vechol shekken) deha beraza illaa dilella, baenan leistammera, ulemehav leh bechol yarcha veyarcha, kad sihara bae leitchaddeta, chad sair, begin dela yekatreg chaddetuta (nusach acher chedvavta) veyittol chulakeh kadka chaze leh. vesihara kaddisha leyanka bikdushsha lechaddetute kedka yeot.

Vechad mitchaddesha bechol yarcha veyarcha, begin (Bereshit 149 amud bet) kach ikre naar, veha okimna. vehay achara da, deihu tadir bimsaavu, vela nafik minne, ikre melech zaken uchesil. uvegin kach, yisrael kaddishin deinnun amma chad, beyichuda kaddisha, kudesha berich hu yahiv lon eta, leishtezava mikkolla. zakkain innun bealma den, uvealma deate, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer.
Zohar, Pinchas 59: Hacha afligu ammudin kadmain dealma. chad amar, iyyov mechaside umot haolam hava. vechad amar, mechaside yisrael hava. vealke, lechappera al alma. deha yoma chad ashkecheh rav hamenuna leeliyyahu. amar leh, vadday tanenan deit tzaddik vera lo, rasha vetov lo. amar, tzaddik, kol shemmemuatin lo chovotav notnin lo baolam hazze chovo, veal ken tzaddik vera lo. vechol shemrubbin avonotav, umemuatin zachiotav, notnin lo secharo baolam hazze, rasha vetov lo. amar leh, dinoy demare alma atikin (sefer acher amikin) aval beshaata devae kudesha berich hu lechappera chovin dealma, alke bidroa dilhon, vease lechulehu. metal leasyay, dealke lidroa, leshezava lechol shayyfin. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 53:5) vehu mecholal mippeshaenu vegomer. (218)
Zohar, Pinchas 61: Ketiv (Vayikra 9:10) hayyoteret min hakkaved. uchetiv (Vayikra 3:4) veet hayyoteret al hakkaved. (batar deavidat niufa, istelik aleh.) yoteret min hakkaved, da eshet zenunim, deazla venafka min hakkaved, leastaa bene alma, uleastena alayyhu. veshavkat lidchura, lemebad zenunim. uvegin da hayyoteret min hakkaved, yoteret al hakkaved. batar deavdat niufa, istalakat aleh. metzach ishsha zona. itgabberat al balah deihu kaved, bechaas demara, eshet medanim, vachaas, deshalta ihi al dechura dilah. metzach ishsha zona shalta al hakkaved, eshet medanim vachaas.

Yoteret min hakkaved, min hakkaved nafka leavasha lechol alma, ulemebad niufin im kolla. levatar ihi salleka legabbe dechora, metzach ishsha zona, beazzuta deanpin, ucheden ihi al hakkaved. veod, yoteret min hakkaved itkeriat missitra achara, batar denafkat lenaafa im kolla, yehivat shiyyurin levalah, vehay ihi yoteret min hakkaved.

Miggo kaved, veyoteret dilah, nafkat mara, veihi charba demalach hammavt, denafku minnah tippin meriran lekatla bene nasha. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:4) veacharitah mara challaana. veihi talya bakkaved, kol marin umota beh talyayn. vehahu yoma derosh hashshana (mashetanea) meshatteta bealma, lemichnash kol chove alma ucheden kol evarin deinnun yisrael, innun beaku, deinnun evare dematronita, (Mishlei 20:27) ner Adonai nishmat adam, shechinta kaddisha. ucheden kol yisrael beaku, venatle shofar leatteara beh hahu tekia ushevarim uterua.

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, vday batar deevarim vearkin delibba, dedamyayn leyisrael, innun beaku. tzerichin leatteara bekane, deihu shofar. veda kane derea. batar dechanfe rea la yachlin leshakkecha rugeza demara deitgabbart al arkin delibba, veal kol arkin deevarim degufa. hahu rucha denashiv behon, salik bekane, deihu shofar, alma deate. dehachi okmuha, veshet, dome lealma den, deveh achila ushetiyya. kane, dome lealma deate, delet beh achila ushetiyya.

Ulevatar deshat 6 min veshet, beribbuy achila degezel itarach veitavid satan. uman garim da. (Bamidbar 11:8) shatu haam velaktu, shatuta dilhon deitarvu beerev rav shatyayn, detaava dilhon achila ushetiyya degezel vechamas, (Tehillim 12:6) deshod aniyyim veenkat evyonim. benun kefufa shatyayn, deachlin bela techina. ma ketiv behu, (Bamidbar 11:33) habbasar odennu ben shinnehem terem yikkaret veaf Adonai chara vaam. itpeshat 6 deshatu, ihu derucheh kafuf, veihu 50. veda garam deitpeshat satan baachila ushetiyya, veitgebar al kol evarin vearkin beshs lo taase. kechusheban hassatan chaser chad, da yom hakkippurim, delet beh achila ushetiyya.

Veihu kegavvna dekane, veihu 6 ben yah, min bina. uvegineh ukemuha mare matnitin, haroe kane bachalom, zoche lachachma. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 4:Adonai) kene chachma kene vina. delet kane deihu pachut mittarvavyyhu, deinnun 10 chachma, Adonai bina. uvegin da, tzarich leitteara bashshofar, deihu kane, alma deate, olam aroch, erech appayim, demishtakkeche minneh 13 mechilin derachame, kechushevan vav, 1 erech, 6 6 appayim.

Veimma illaa ihi tekia, missitra deavraham. shevarim, missitra deyitzchak. terua, missitra deyaakov. shechinta tattaa, kesher dechullehu. dehayynu: 100 tekia. 300 shevarim. Rabbi terua. vechullehu meshullashin legabbe shechinta, hada hu dichtiv, kedushsha lecha yeshalleshu. delet kala yachil lenafka levar, ella min happe. uf hachi, let leafresha shechinta min kudesha berich hu. dekudesha berich hu ittemar beh, (Tehillim 29:7) kol Adonai chotzev lahavot esh. ushechinta tefillat kol pe. veinnun simanin, 700 500 400. (ad kan).
Natlin shofar, leitteara beh, terua utekia, dina kashya berachame, ushevarim dina kashya bela rachame (sefer acher dina rafya berachame) ucheden hachi yittearu leella leitarva da beda.

Raya mehemna uvechibbura kadmaa, amar raya mehemana, behay itbesam satan, vekamit nun min veshet, ma dehava satan lefanim, tav laachora, veithaddar veshet, kidbekadmeta. begin dehakkol kol yaakov. yisrael let chelehon baachila ushetiyya, kishar ammin, deyartin alma den, dechelehon baachila ushetiyya. ella chelehon bekol da, deihu alma deate, olam aroch, deitbere beat yod, uvegin dekol shofar minneh nafik, amru rabbanan en pochatin measara shofarot. uveot 10 vadday, itavid olam aroch, deihu 6 alma deate uveat Adonai, bara alma den, deihi Adonai zeera, devah achila ushetiyya deorayyta.

Veod raza achara, batar deitgezar gezera bitren atvavn, deinnun Adonai Adonai, teren batte dinin, man yachil levattela gezera detarvavyyhu. 16. deat hei imma illaa. 10 av. uma ketiv, (Bamidbar 30:14) kol neder vechol shevuat issar leanot nafesh, deihi Adonai, ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu. uvegin da, tzarich leatteara kala deihu 6, baasara shofarot, deinnun 10. veikkara dilhon binshima achat, kol siman vesiman, bappe, deihi 10 measara.

Miyyad deshamu millin rabbi shimon vechol chavrayyay, amru, berich elaha dezachena lemishma millin, mehahu deitkere rabban shel neviim, rabban dachachamim, rabban demalache hashsharet, dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh medabber al pumoy, vechatav al yedoy razin illen, dela ishtemau kevavtayyhu mimmattan tora, vead kean.

Amar leh, botzina kaddisha, ashlim millule derazin dechibbura kadmaa, lefarsha lon, deha kol mare metivtan dilella, umare metivtan diltatta, kullehu mezumanin lemishma millin illen mippumach, ufirushin dilach. deha chedva ufurekana, yittear behon leella vetatta. al tittenu domi, lo ant, vechol siata dilach. (ad kan raya mehemana).
Zohar, Vayakhel 16: Tzelota deshabbeta, deamma kaddisha, telat tzelotin ishtechachu behay yoma, lokovel telat shabbate, veukemuha, vechullehu chad. kevan dealu amma kaddisha leve kenishta, asir leishtaddela afillu betzorech be kenishta, ella bemille tushebchan utzelota, veorayyta, vechadka chaze lon.

Uman (206 amud alef, emor 105 amud alef) deishtaddal bemillin acharanin, uvemillin dealma, da ihu bar nash deka mechallel shabbeta, let leh chulaka beamma deyisrael. teren malachin memanan al da, beyoma deshabbeta, veinnun shavu yedehon al resheh, veamre, vavy liflanyya, delet leh chulaka bekudesha berich hu. veal da, bae leishtaddela bitzlota uveshirin uvetushebchan demarehon, uleishtaddela beorayyta.

Hay yoma, ihu yoma denishmatin, deitattera hahu tzerora denishmatin. (betushebchan demarehon) begin kach meshabbeche betushebchan tushbachta denishmeta, vehayeynu (138 amud alef) nishmat kol chay tevarech et shimcha Adonai elohenu veruach kol basar vechulei. velet tushebachta ella besitra denishmeta verucha, vehay yoma, kayyeyma berucha venishmeta, velav degufa.

Tushebachta dedarga achara illaa, raza deyoma, shimsha kaddisha deihu nehora dimama, hayeynu yotzer or. raza dinhora denahir, deminneh itzenan venaharin kol innun chayyaylin, retichin, vechochavayya umazzale, vechol innun deshaltin al alma.
Tushebachta dealma deate beyoma da, hayeynu el adon. vetushebachta da, ihu beraza deesrin uteren atvavn illain kaddishin, demitatteran baavahan uvirticha illaa kaddisha.

Atvavn (hakedama 3 amud bet) zeirin, innun esrin uteren atvavn, deinnun bealma tattaa, deinnun el baruch gedol dea vechulei, vela it ben teva latteva, revavcha achara, ella at reshima bechol teva veteva. (132 amud bet) uvealma illaa, it revavcha, vesitrin kaddishin, ben at leat. veda ihu, tushebachta al tushebachta, deatvavn illain deyoma sheviaa, (204 amud alef) ka meshabbach veamar lemalka illaa yotzer bereshit.

Kad tushebachta da salleka leella, shitin retichin illain dekaamaran, mizdammenin venatle lehay tushebachta meamma kaddisha, vesalke lah leitattera ba, bechamma retichin illain, di memanan, vechol innun tzaddikayyay divginta deeden, kullehu mitatterin betushebachta da, vechol innun retichin, vechol innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, kullehu sallekin betushebachta da, ad raza dechuresyyay.

Kad mata lechuresyay kaddisha, tushebachta da dechol yisrael, kayyeyma tamman, ad zimna dekamre kedushsha illaa demusaf. ucheden silluka diltatta leella, leitachada kolla leella leella, lemeheve kolla chad. da ihi tushebachta, desalleka al kullehu tushebchan.

Mikkan ulehala, siddura ditzlota dishar yome, ad yismach moshe vechulei, chedvavta dedarga illaa, ikkara daavahan, dechadde behahu adva dileh, kad salik kuresyyay legabbeh, venatil lah, umitchabberan kachada. veda ihu chedva deorayyta illaa dilella, tora shebbichtav. dechadde beorayyta diltatta, tora shebbeal pe, veitchabbaru da beda.
Kevan deitchabbaru kachada, bae bar nash leachlela behahu chedva leamma kaddisha, yismechu vemalchutach shomre shabbat vechulei, elohenu velohe avotenu retze na vimnuchatenu.
Zohar, Vayechi 35: Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Bereshit 15:12) vayhi hashshemesh lavo vetardema nafla al avram vegomer, hay kera ukemuha. aval da yoma dedina kashya, deafke leh lebar nash mehay alma. detanya, (hahu yoma) zimna demata devar nash nafik mehay alma, hahu (yoma) zimna yoma dedina rabba, deitchashshach shimsha min sihara, kema dichtiv, (Kohelet 12:2) ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh, da nishmata kaddisha, deitmenaat mibbar nash, telatin yomin, ad la yippuk mealma (veha chaze), vechama detzulema deitmenaat minneh vela itchaze.

May tama itmenaat minneh. begin denishmeta kaddisha salkat, veitavarat minneh, vela itchaze. dela tema, dechad mit bar nash veitchallash, hay nishmata itavarat minneh, ella kad ihu bechayyav, betukepeh, itavarat minneh (veitchallash) hay nishmeta, vela nahara lerucha, verucha la nahir lenafsha, keden tzulema itavarat minneh, vela nahir leh. (ella) mehahu yoma, kolla machreze aleh, veafillu tzippore shemaya. may tama. begin denishmata ha salka minneh, verucha la nahir lenafsha, keden nafsha itchallashat, umechla vechol tiuveta degufa, salka minneh veitavar.

Veamar ribbi yehuda, veafillu kol zimna denafil inish beve mareh, vela yachil letzallaa, nishmata itavarat vesalka minneh, ucheden la nahir rucha lenafsha, ad dedayynin dinih devar nash. vei dayynin leh levar nash letav, keden nishmata ithadderat leatrah, unehira lecholla. ha bezimna dekayyma milla bedina. uvezimna dela kayyma milla bedina, telatin yomin akdimat nishmata lecholla, vetzulema itavar minneh.

Tana, bezimna dedayynin leh levar nash leela, salkin lenishmateh leve dina, vedayynin al memraha, vehi ashidat becholla, veashidat bechol raayoni devar nash, uveovadin la ashidat, deha kullehu besifra chetivin. vechullehu dayynin leh lebar nash, behahi shata dedayynin leh lebar nash leela, keden dochaka degufa ishtakkach, yattir mishshear zimnayay.

I dayynin leh letav, keden arpin minneh. vezea itbakka al gufa, venishmata ahadderat levatar, venahara lecholla. vela salik bar nash mibbe mareh lealmin, ad dedayynin dineh leela. vei tema, ha kamma chayyayve alma, kamma rashshie alma, kayymin bekiyyumayyhu. ella, kudesha berich hu ashgach bedineh debar nash, af al gav dehashta la zache, vehu chame deha levatar zache, dain leh letav. o lezimnin deolid bar, deyeheve zakkaa bealma, veal da kudesha berich hu dain leh letav.

Vechol ovadoy vedinoy dekudesha berich hu letav, uvecholla ashgach. kema dichtiv, (yechezkel 33:11) chay ani neum Adonai vegomer im echpotz bemot harasha ki im beshuv rasha middarko. uvegin da, kol inun chayyayve alma, dekayymin bekiyyumayyhu, kudesha berich hu dain lon letav.

Ulezimnin, deinun marin ishtallimu zimnayyhu, millemishre tamman. kema deat amer, (Devarim 28:59) vocholaim raim veneemanim, deavadu mehemnuta. dechad sharian aleh devar nash, mistalleke minneh levatar deashlimu zimnayyhu, ben letzaddikayay, ben lechayyayvaya, vecholla itavad bedina kidkaamaran:

Vayyar yisrael et bene yosef vayyomer mi elle, amar ribbi yitzchak, hay kera kashya, dichtiv vayyar yisrael, uchetiv veene yisrael kavdu mizzoken lo yuchal lirot, i lo yuchal lirot, mahu vayyar yisrael. ella dechama beruach kudesha, inun bene yosef, deinun yaravam vachaverav. deyaravam avad teren egle zahav, veamar (Melachim 1 12) elle elohecha yisrael. uvegin kach, mi elle, man hu dezammin lememar elle elohecha letaavavn ochoran, uvegin kach vayyar yisrael et bene yosef.

Mikkan, detzaddikayay chaman ovada lemerachok, vekudesha berich hu meatter lon beitra dileh, ma kudesha berich hu chame lemerachok, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:31) vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinne tov meod, dekudesha berich hu chama kol ovadin, ad la yaaved lon, vechullehu aavaru kammeh.

Kegavvna da, kol darin dealma, misseyayfe alma, ad seyayfe alma, kullehu itattadu vekayymu kammeh ad la yetun lealma. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 41:4) kore haddorot merosh, ad la itbere alma. begin dechol nishmatin denachatin lealma, ad la yechatun, kullehu kayyme kammeh dekudesha berich hu, bediukena dekayyme behay alma, veikrun bishmahan, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) lechullam beshem yikra.

Uf hachi tzaddikayyay, kudesha berich hu achme lon kol darin dealma, ad la yetun veyishtakkechun bealma. mena lan meadam (da adam) dehava kadmaa. dekudesha berich hu achme leh kol inun darin ad la yetun, kedichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:1) ze sefer toldot (adam). detaninan, achme leh, kol inun darin dezamminin lemete lealma. vechen lemoshe, dichtiv, (Devarim la) vayyarehu Adonai et kol haaretz, dekudesha berich hu achme leh kol darin dealma, vechol inun manhige alma, vechol shear nevie, ad la yetun lealma.

Uf hacha, vayyar yisrael et bene yosef, chama lemerachok, veizdaza, veamar mi elle. vehay kera ashlim litren sitrin, lehay sitra, ulehay sitra. veal da ativ yosef veamar, banay hem asher natan li elohim baze. umena lan dekudesha berich hu achme leh berucha dekudesha. dichtiv vehinni hera oti elohim gam et zarecha. gam, leasgaa inun denafkin minneh kidkaamaran:

rashi: Tziyyon kedosh yisrael. "tziyyon deitrei vah kaddisha deyisrael" (targum yonatan), tziyyon shel kedosh yisrael:
targum: Vihachun legavich kefifin bene meshabedayich veyishtattechun lemive minich al parsat riglich kol dahavo margezin lich veyikron lich karta dayya tzion deitree vah kadisha deyisrael:

rashi: Lichrot et bene yisrael. sheyyekabbelu alehem et hattora beala uvishvua:
Millevad habberit. kelalot shebbetorat kohanim shenneemru vesinay:

Vesamachta vechol hattov. mikkan amru en korin mikra vikkurim ella vizman simcha, meatzeret vead hechag, sheadam melakket tevuato uferotav veyeno veshamno, aval mehechag vaelach mevi veeno kore (fesachim 36):
Atta vehallevi. af hallevi chayyav bevikkurim im natu betoch arehem:
Vehagger asher bekirbecha. mevi veeno kore, sheeno yachol lomar laavotenu (talmud yerushalmi 340 85 10):
Vayyilbash kelala. hichnis atzmo biklala, venocha lo perikat ol hakkarban uvirkat kohanim vekillat haummot:
targum: Ulevash levata hech levusha vaalat hech maya begushemeh vehech mishcha beevaroy:

rashi: Vaavadtem sham elohim acherim. ketargumo — lo avodat elohut mammash ella maalim mas vegulgoliyyot lechumere aza:
Yachselennu. yechallennu, veal shem kach nikra chasil, shemmechalle et hakkol:
Vayyeehav kelala. killato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shekkafar bo:
targum: Verachem levataya veatyat leh vela itree bevircheta veitrachakat mineh:

ohc: Yiftach Adonai vegomer. mikkan matchil yiud hattov shekkeneged maase hammitzvot ad levassof, velaze gamar omer ki tishma el mitzvot Adonai elohecha – ellu mitzvot ase. vehinne yiudim ellu hem mechuvvanim keneged kiyyum hammitzvot, ki al yede hammitzvot mitpattechim tzinnore hashshefa umityachadim hammiddot haelyonot.

Veamar yiftach Adonai lecha bechinnuy, shemmavticho Adonai sheyyiftach lo, perush bishvilo levad. hakkavvana, hagam sheyyesovvu acherim listom, beemtzaut hatztzaddik yippatach otzar hattov, veshem hattov hu sod hannahar, vehu sod (Mishlei 10,25) "tzaddik yesod olam". veamro et hashshamayim hu sod hashepaa elyona lemala kayyadua leyode chen.

Veamro vehilvita goyim rabbim veatta lo tilve, hinne yadua shebbizman sheyyisrael osim retzono shel makom, hashshefa shel kol haolam ba al yede yisrael, vehaolam kullo nizzon mittamtzit am bene yisrael, ulehefech nizzonin yisrael mittachat yede haummot. laze amar "vehilvita goyim rabbim veatta lo tilve" mimmennu. hutzrach lomar "veatta lo tilve", sheim lo chen en hekker labberacha, ki derech haolam hu shehaggedolim vehaashirim lovim ze mizze, uleachar mikken chozer gam ken hammalve velove mimmennu. laze amar veatta lo tilve, uvaze yihye hekker lemaamar "vehilvita".

Veamro unetancha Adonai lerosh vegomer, perush sheyyihyu yisrael tachat memshelet rosh haolam shehu elohe yisrael, velo lezanav shehem sare mala, uvaze tamid yihyu bemadrega haelyona, keamro vehayita rak lemala velo tihye lematta, al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, vayyetze) befasuk (yirmeya 30:10) "veatta al tira avdi yaakov" sheraa yaakov bassullam olim veachar kach yordim, chashav sheggam hu chen achar sheyyaale yered, talmud lomar "al tira" vegomer, vehu amro "velo tihye lematta". hattaam ki tishma vegomer, perush keneged mitzvot ase kemo sheggamar omer velaasot. vetaam shello amar beferush "ki taase mitzvot", lefi sheyyesh mitzvot kamma vechamma sheenam beyad haadam laasotam, laze amar ki tishma vegomer velaasot, perush, tekabbel alecha laasot. vetaam amro lishmor beyiud ze, ba hakkatuv lehodia ki en yiud lemitzvot ase ella achar shehikdim lahem shemirat mitzvot lo taase, sheim lo chen zivche reshaim toeva, vechol mitzva sheose baal averot shora aleha sitra ochora veenah osa peri, laze hikdim lomar "lishmor" veachar kach amar "velaasot" shehu maase hammitzvot shealav bau hayyiudim hattovim haamurim mivhotircha" ad sof.

rashi: Mashge ivver. hassuma vaddavar umassio etza raa:

Levarech et haam. kidita vemassechet sota (daf 32): shishsha shevatim alu lerosh har gerizim veshishsha lerosh har eval vehakkohanim vehaleviyyim vehaaron lematta baemtza, hafchu leviyyim penehem kelappe har gerizim ufatchu vabberacha, "baruch haish asher lo yaase fesel umassecha vegomer", veellu vaellu onin amen. chazru vehafchu penehem kelappe har eval ufatchu vakkelala veomrim "arur haish asher yaase fesel vegomer", vechen kullam ad "arur asher lo yakim":
Lirkamot tuval lammelech. bevigde rikma yevium mincha lammelech al kol haaretz. rekamot 313 belaaz, ze shenneemar "veheviu et kol achechem mikkol haggoyim mincha vegomer" (Yeshayahu 66:20):
Betulot achareha reoteha. yelchu acharehem keinyan shenneemar (Zecharya 8:23) "vehecheziku bichnaf ish yehudi vegomer lemor nelcha immachem ki shamanu elohim immachem":
Muvaot lach. kelappe hakkadosh baruch hu amar hameshorer:
targum: Bilvushe tziurin yekarvun kurebanehon kodam malka dealma ushear chavrehon di mitbadrin bene ammaya yittetyan bechedva levatach lirushelem:

rashi: Mishshamayim hishmata din. keshennitnabbe yeshaya al pureanuto shel sancheriv, venitkayyem bo: eretz yisrael, sheyyara mimmennu umeuchelusav, az shakata:
targum: Min shemaya ashmata din ara deamme dechilat ara deyisrael shedochat:

ohc: Lemaan asher tavo. rabbi avraham ibben ezra peresh: im hachillota lishmor mitzvotav, vezo mitzva rishona vechulei, veramban peresh lirmoz el hattora vechulei, veen hakkatuv mityashshev lishne happerushim. veyesh lehair od amro kaasher dibber Adonai elohe avotecha lach, shello haya tzarich lomar tevat "lach" achar sheamar "asher tavo el haaretz kaasher" vegomer, haddavar muvan shealehem hu haddavar.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv, lefi shekkadam maamar moshe leyisrael ki biat haaretz lo bizchut yisrael, keamro (Devarim 9:5) "lo vetzidkatcha" vegomer, ella "berishat haggoyim vegomer ulemaan hakim" vegomer. laze ba devaro kan, ki beemtzaut hammaase haamur bainyan tihye biatam laaretz bizchut atzmam, ugezerat hakkatuv hi tevat "lach" haamur levassof. veze shiur hakkatuv "lemaan asher tavo", perush tihye biatcha laaretz "asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha kaasher vegomer lach", perush, lemaan sheatta rauy velo titztarech lizchut berit avot, vehaven:

rashi: Shenat ratzon. shenat piyyus veritztzuy:
targum: Lemikre shenat raava kodam Adonai veyom pureanuta kodam elahana lenachama kol avelaya:

rashi: Venishartem bimte meat tachat vegomer. muatin chelef merubbim:
Hammeera. chissaron, kemo "tzaraat mameret" (Vayikra 13):
Hammehuma. shiggush, kol behalot:
Velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha. lehanif oto, kohen maniach yado tachat yad habbealim umenif (socha 47):
Bishchin mitzrayim. ra haya meod, lach mibbifnim veyavesh mibbachutz, kidita bivchorot (daf 41):
Garav. shechin lach:
Cheres. shechin yavesh kacheres:
Shamor et kol hammitzva. leshon hove, 266 belaaz:
ohc: Vaytzav moshe vezikne yisrael. taam zichron zikne yisrael kan, nitkavven moshe baze ma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (berachot 19:) shebbemakom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav, dichtiv (Mishlei 21:30) "en chachma vegomer leneged Adonai", vehu amro "vaytzav moshe" ulefanav shehu rabban shel yisrael asa sheggam hazzekenim yetzauu veyazhiru al haddavar lemor "shamor" vegomer. dikdek lomar shamor lehair ki bedavar ze shehu mitzvat lo taase (makkot 13:) hu sheamru en cholkin kavod larav kayyadua.

rashi: Hashekifa mimmeon kodshecha. asinu ma sheggazarta alenu, ase atta ma shealecha laasot (sifre), sheamarta (Vayikra 26) "im bechukkotay telechu … venatatti gishmechem beittam":
Asher natatta lanu kaasher nishbata laavotenu. latet lanu vekiyyamta — eretz zavat chalav udevash:
ohc: Hashekifa mimmeon vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar mimmeon vegomer min hashshamayim, veim lechannot shem mekomo yitbarach bilshon kedushsha haya lo lomar al ze hadderech: "hashekifa mimmeon vegomer hashshamayim".

Venire shehakkatuv yair sod echad, vehu ki haadon baruch hu hechin shete hashepaot lemala: 1 hashepaat haruchaniyyut shehem hannefashot hattehorot, veechad hashepaat hattov lechayyot hannivraim shehu mazon lakkol. ushenayim ellu yikreu lahem rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Zohar hakkadosh) ziuug, shekkol sheyyesh bivchinat mashpia uvechinat nishpa yittachnu beshem ziuug. veamru hammekubbalim shemmiyyom shennecherav habbayit nifsak hashepaat hanneshamot velo nishar ella hashepaat chayyut haolamot, shehu muchrach lekiyyum haolamot. vehu amro hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha keneged hashepaat hanneshamot, vehashekafa zo hi elyona bemakom gavoah hannikra kodesh. uchevar gillu hammekubbalim (Zohar chelek 2 121.) ma ben haderagat kodesh lehaderagat kadosh ki kadosh lemala, vehammaskil yavin. ucheneged hashepaat chayyut haolamot amar "min hashshamayim", ze ziuug lematta meharishon. veamar keneged maamar "hashekifa" – "uvarech et ammecha", ufershu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (maaser shene perek Adonai mishna 13) bevanim uvanot. veze yatzdik perushenu sheal ziuug hanneshamot hu omer. ucheneged maamar "min hashshamayim" amar "veet haadama" shehi birkat hammazon, venachon.

rashi: Yaan mashach. en meshicha zo, ella leshon serara ugedulla:
Likro lishvuyim deror. kelomar, levasser lahem besorat haggeulla:
Pekach koach. pekach et malkocham veshivyam vehattirem:
targum: Amar neviya ruach nevua min kodam Adonai elohim alay chalaf derabbe yati Adonai levasara invetanaya shalchani letakafa litvire libba lemikre ledishvan cheru velidasirin itgelu lenehor:

rashi: Nidru veshallemu. nidrechem:
Kol sevivav. hashshomim teshua zo, vechen asu, kemo shekkatuv (Yeshayahu 19:18) "yihyu chamesh arim beeretz mitzrayim medabberot sefat kenaan venishbaot laAdonai tzevaot":
Yovilu shay lammora. lamma? lefi shebbeet cheftzo:
targum: Nedaru nidrin veshalimu kodam Adonai elahachon kol deyatvin chazor chazor lemakdesheh yaytun kurebnaya levet mikdash dechil:

rashi: Merov kol. beod shehaya lecha kol tuv:
ohc: Tachat asher lo avadta vegomer. onesh ze vehabba acharav ad amro "im lo tishmor" hu keneged bittul mitzvot ase sherasham befasuk (Devarim 28:58) "im lo tishmor laasot" vegomer; veamar tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai, perush, laasot mitzvot asher tzivvecha laasot besimcha, laze "veavadta et oyvecha beraav uvetzama" vegomer, atta parakta ol hammitzva mealecha – yitten oyvecha ol barzel al tzavvarecha. voonashim ellu hem mechuvvanim keneged perikat ol mitzvot ase. atta shello ratzita litroach lehavin ulehaskil seder maase hammitzvot, yissa Adonai alecha goy asher lo tishma leshono vegomer, vechen kullan.

Vegamar omer im lo tishmor laasot, lehodia ki al kiyyum mitzvot ase hu maanish, vechalal kol mitzvot ase bemitzvat hayyira, ki hi mitzvat ase kemo shekkatav rambam bitchillat sefer hammadda (hilchot yesode hattora perek 2), veze leshono: hashshem hannichbad vechulei mitzva leyira vechulei. vetaam shello amar "im lo taasu", katavti lemala (Devarim 27:26) taam shello yechayyev laasot bederech kelal ella lishmor laasot kesheyyavo leyado uchesheyyassig laasot.

O efshar sheppasuk ze ba lomar al derech amro (Vayikra 26:23) "veim beelle lo tivvasru li", perush, sheim achar kol haamur lo yishmor laasot vegomer leyira Adonai hannichbad vehannora, sheachar shehevi alav kol hakkelalot yihye beenav nora meod ki raa asher yissero. vedikdek lomar tishmor laasot keneged mitzvot lo taase umitzvot ase, vehodia sheyyafli Adonai od bo makkot gedolot vechol haamur bainyan.

Vegamar omer venishartem bimte meat vegomer tachat asher vegomer ki lo shamata bekol Adonai elohecha – ze keneged ma shello asa teshuva al bittul talmud tora. vehaya kaasher sas vegomer – leval yomar adam achar sheyyadanu ki Adonai elohenu middotav kullan middot hachesed veharachamim, middotav yimnauhu mehaarich od batztzarot veyiref yado. laze hodia ki simcha hi lo kaasher sas vegomer, uchefi ze en hatteva katz mehassemachot. vechayyotze baze amar hakkatuv (Mishlei 11:10) "baavod reshaim rinna". vechen darshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin lat:) befasuk (Melachim 1 22:36) "vattaavor harinna", shehaya baavod achav ben amri rinna lifne Adonai. veyonatan tirgem "yasis Adonai" – yechde memra da alechon ammin nucherain vechulei, vedikdek "yasis" poal yotze laacherim. af al pi chen peshat hakkatuv enah neekeret mimmekomah uchemo shettirgem uneklos, ella sheyyonatan ben uziel darash hakkatuv.

Veraiti lehair, lamma lo neemru nechamot bakkelalot haellu kasseder haamur bakkelalot shebbefarashat bechukkotay (Vayikra 26:42-44). gam yesh lehair lamma kafal hakkelalot velo hispik kelalot sheamar befarashat bechukkotay?

Venire ki hutzrach lichpol hakkelalot, lefi shekkelalot shebbefarashat bechukkotay neemru lichlalut yisrael, shekken neemru kullam bilshon rabbim mittechillatam vead sofam, veyesh makom lomar sheim chelek miyyisrael yetivu maasehem en Adonai makpid al chelek hammarshia. laze bau kelalot haamurim befarasha zo veneemru kullan bilshon yachid, venitkavven ledabber ben beerech yachid mammash ben beerech chelek miyyisrael, hagam sheyyihyu rabbim beerech kelalut yisrael yityaches lahem yachid. velaze timtza sheamar vehayu shamecha asher al roshcha vegomer, yissa Adonai alecha goy merachok, ze keneged chelek miyyisrael, hagam shehem rabbim yomar lahem leshon yachid mittaam shekkatavnu. veamar gam ken "ishsha teares" vegomer, "bayit tivne" vegomer, setamo beyachid mammash.

Umeatta hirvachnu lamma lo neemra nechama bahem, ki lo neemra nechama ella bakkelala shehem lichlalut yisrael, ki lo yaazvem lechallotam vesheyyizkor lahem berit avotam gam yizkor haaretz, ma sheen ken hayyechidim mehem ki yarshiu – esh tochlem ad olam. vahalo timtza shetztzivva Adonai leabbed ir miyyisrael ulesumah tel olam vehi ir hanniddachat (Devarim 13:14-19), veen tzarich lomar adam ki yarshia lahamito bevet din, uma nechama yesh laze achar avdo. vechen timtza befarashat nitztzavim keshehizkir Adonai rishat mishpacha achat veshevet amar (Devarim 29:19) "umacha Adonai et shemo" vegomer velo hizkir nechamato, uchemo chen bakkelalot haamurim befarasha zo leheyotam lichidim miyyisrael.

Veal yikshe beenecha ma sheddibber hakkatuv shetayim o shalosh tevot befarasha zo bilshon rabbim, keamro venishartem mete mispar, lehaavid etchem, vehitmakkartem, ki achar shekkadam ledabber bilshon yachid lo hikpid ligmor omer bilshon rabbim, ki haddevarim muvanim sheal rabbim shebbayyechidim hu omer, vehaed "leoyvecha" leshon yachid.
